# Content Type Model Template

| Field | Required? | Purpose | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| Content type | Yes | Names the artifact | Opportunity profile |
| Strategic purpose | Yes | Explains use | Compare possible pathways |
| Required fields | Yes | Defines completeness | Problem, mechanism, evidence |
| Evidence standard | Yes | Sets proof expectations | Source and confidence level |
| Decision use | Yes | Connects to choice | Test, advance, hold, revise |
| Owner | Recommended | Maintains quality | Strategy lead |
| Review cycle | Recommended | Prevents decay | Quarterly |
